notes.title: Free!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi[/h1]
Thanks to Everyone who bought the game and thereby supported me.
Yes, something happened to do well, something not. I got different reviews on the game. But it's silly to be offended, I thought. And I decided to make the game [b]free[/b]. 
Community, this is for You.
[h1]Enjoy[/h1]

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween is coming![/h1]
Specially for Halloween I've prepared a grand update package:
[List]
     [*] Trading cards
     [*] New horror elements
     [*] Lighting system changed, new visual effects added
     [*] New sound effects
     [*] Bugs fixed
[/List]
The game became more scary and dynamic. And what else do you need in the dark autumn evenings;)
